text:
sam: Quick heads-up — planning an overnight warmup + pin gate for service v2.3.1 tonight. Want to lock down the off-hours rollback plan and smoke checklist.

maya: Good call. Proposed flow: canary 1% for 15m -> 10% for 30m -> 50% for 30m if metrics look good, then full. Warmup jobs run before canary start.

lex: Agree. Also we should pin the DB migration behind a feature flag; if anything flaps we can flip off without rollback.

sam: Pinning note: we'll pin runtime image to sha: `sha256:6a7b...c9` and service tag `v2.3.1-pin`. No auto-upgrades during the freeze window.

deploy-bot: @channel Deploy scheduled by sam: service/web v2.3.1 -> pinned tag v2.3.1-pin
Command: `kubectl set image deploy/web web=registry/redwood/web@sha256:6a7b...c9`
Status: queued, expected start 2026-03-20T02:00Z

maya: Rollback triggers (proposed):
- error rate increase > 3% over baseline for 10m
- p95 latency > 800ms sustained for 10m
- 5+ 5xx in hotpath per minute
If any trigger hits, auto-notify but require manual ack to execute rollback (off-hours).

oncall-tim: I'm on-call tonight 02:00-10:00 UTC. I'll be main rollback owner if alert fires. @sam please ping mobile if anything noisy.

lex: For auto-actions, let's NOT allow automatic rollback without a human during midnight-08:00 UTC. Auto alerts only.

sam: Agreed. ops-bot can run smoke suite and report results before canary progresses.

ops-bot: Smoke run queued: `smoke/sanity.sh --service web --env staging`
Output (truncated):
```
OK: /health 200
OK: /api/v1/ready 200
Latencies p50=25ms p95=120ms
```

maya: Add extra checks for embeddings/async worker queue length — we saw backlog spikes last release. Gate if queue > 500 for more than 5m.

sam: Noted. Also pin config: `REPLICA_MIN=2`, enable ramped autoscaler but cap to 40% above baseline during canary.

lex: Release notes snippet for ops channel: "v2.3.1: runtime pin, warmup jobs, DB flag for migration, improved batching" — keep short.

sam: Communication plan:
- 01:45 UTC: final go/no-go call in #eng-releases (this thread)
- 01:55 UTC: deploy-bot starts warmup jobs
- 02:00 UTC: canary 1%
- post-canary updates to #eng-releases and #incident if triggered

maya: I'll do the 01:45 quick sweep of dashboards (SLOs, errors, queue length).

oncall-tim: I'll keep phone on. If an alert hits the rollback threshold, I'll post "ROLLBACK: true" here and then run rollback steps.

sam: Rollback steps (off-hours manual):
1) `kubectl rollout undo deploy/web --to-revision=<prev>`
2) revert feature flag for DB migration
3) scale to baseline replicas if autoscaler misbehaves
4) notify #eng-releases + @oncall-tim + paging list

lex: Add an emergency bypass channel: if pager fails, call the infra pager number.

deploy-bot: Canary progression logs:
- 02:00 UTC: canary 1% started
- 02:15 UTC: smoke checks OK -> progressing to 10%

maya: thumbs up on the plan from my side. Will be watching dashboards. :thumbsup:

sam: ok team — final call: any objections to the pin/gate/rollback plan?

lex: No objections.

oncall-tim: No objections. Ready.

sam: Go for launch. I'll post a short release note after full roll.

deploy-bot: Rollout started: web v2.3.1-pin -> canary 1% at 02:00 UTC. Logs will stream to /var/log/deploys/web-3267.log

ops-bot: Warmup job completed. Cache primed for popular prefixes (~1200 keys warmed).

sam: thanks everyone — keeping thread for postmortem notes if anything weird shows up.

lex: If we end up rolling back, please include the exact `kubectl` outputs and timestamps.

maya: I'll capture graph snapshots pre/post and attach in follow-up.

sam: closing thread for now. Ping here for any alerts. :rocket:
